crossRefs.note: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and dead…

parallels.note: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain…
On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

people.name: Gilboa_Mount
people.line: A mountain range where Saul and his sons died.

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
translations.bsb: The next day, when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
translations.asv: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
